mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_wallet ( user_id, balance_units, frozen_units, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{balanceUnits}, #{frozenUnits}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, balance_units AS balanceUnits, frozen_units AS frozenUnits, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, balance_units AS balanceUnits, frozen_units AS frozenUnits, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE router_wallet SET balance_units = balance_units + (#{reserveUnits} - #{actualCostUnits}), frozen_units = frozen_units - #{reserveUnits}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND #{reserveUnits} > 0 AND #{actualCostUnits} >= 0 AND frozen_units >= #{reserveUnits} AND balance_units >= GREATEST(#{actualCostUnits} - #{reserveUnits}, 0) AND balance_units <= 9223372036854775807 - GREATEST(#{reserveUnits} - #{actualCostUnits}, 0)
